independent_read_only_review: No result-affecting geometry, action, units, source, solver, or FRD mapping defect found. S4 work independently recomputed from force times mean face displacement. FRD rounding is far below the observed S4-E4 work gap.
interpretation: The x8-to-x16 S8R continuous-action work increase shows this independent reference has not converged. At fixed S8R x8, Q4 nodal projection lowers work substantially. At fixed Q4 nodal action and grid, S4 and E4 are close in scale while S8R is substantially more compliant. This supports a strong trial/trace-space contribution to the earlier discrepancy, not a unique constitutive, locking, or physical connection diagnosis.
